description: **Blast radius scoring:** use PageRank + co-change history to rank file importance relative to a change set. High-PageRank files get extra review attention. Co-change clusters surface "you probably also need to update Y" warnings. Inspired by [SoulForge](https://github.com/ProxySoul/soulforge) (174 stars). Graph source: SmartMemory backend from STRAT-CODEGRAPH-1 (2026-10-05).
phase: STRAT-CODEGRAPH: Code Graph Context for Agents
